verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽיהוָ֨ה׀ חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י נוּדוּ צִפּֽוֹר׃ הַרְכֶ֥ם
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh ḥā·sî·ṯî ’êḵ tō·mə·rū lə·nap̄·šî nū·ḏū ṣip·pō·wr har·ḵem
verses.literal: For the choirmaster Of David In the LORD I take refuge How then can you say to me Flee like a bird to your mountain

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל־ יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ־ אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh hā·rə·šā·‘îm yiḏ·rə·ḵūn qe·šeṯ kō·wn·nū ḥiṣ·ṣām ‘al- ye·ṯer lî·rō·wṯ bə·mōw- ’ō·p̄el lə·yiš·rê- lêḇ
verses.literal: For behold the wicked bend [their] bows They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ֭שָּׁתוֹת יֵֽהָרֵס֑וּן מַה־ צַ֝דִּ֗יק פָּעָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî haš·šā·ṯō·wṯ yê·hā·rê·sūn mah- ṣad·dîq pā·‘āl
verses.literal: If the foundations are destroyed what can the righteous do

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ קָדְשׁ֗וֹ בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל יְהוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֪יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh qā·ḏə·šōw bə·hê·ḵal Yah·weh baš·šā·ma·yim kis·’ōw ‘ê·nāw ye·ḥĕ·zū ‘ap̄·‘ap·pāw yiḇ·ḥă·nū bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: The LORD is in His holy temple the LORD is on His heavenly throne His eyes are watching closely [they] examine the sons of men

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ יִ֫בְחָ֥ן צַדִּ֪יק וְ֭רָשָׁע נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃ שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiḇ·ḥān ṣad·dîq wə·rā·šā‘ nap̄·šōw śā·nə·’āh wə·’ō·hêḇ ḥā·mās
verses.literal: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked His soul hates the lover of violence

verses.original: עַל־ רְשָׁעִ֗ים יַמְטֵ֥ר אֵ֣שׁ פַּ֫חִ֥ים וְ֭גָפְרִית זִלְעָפ֗וֹת וְר֥וּחַ מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- rə·šā·‘îm yam·ṭêr ’êš pa·ḥîm wə·ḡā·p̄ə·rîṯ zil·‘ā·p̄ō·wṯ wə·rū·aḥ mə·nāṯ kō·w·sām
verses.literal: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur a scorching wind will be their portion . . .

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה צַדִּ֣יק אָהֵ֑ב צְדָק֣וֹת יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh ṣad·dîq ’ā·hêḇ ṣə·ḏā·qō·wṯ yā·šār ye·ḥĕ·zū p̄ā·nê·mōw
verses.literal: For the LORD is righteous He loves justice The upright will see His face
